entries.note: The merchant booked the parcel; the remark gives the planned pickup day.
An older booking's first scan, at the same second as its booking confirmation.
The rider did not come for the parcel; the remark gives the reason and the page the next pickup day.
A rider was assigned to collect the parcel.
The rider is on the way to collect the parcel.
The rider collected the parcel from the merchant.
The origin hub received the parcel; the remark names the hub.
The sorting centre received the parcel, then sorted and bagged it.
The parcel moves between hubs; remarks also carry partner scans under this status.
The hub of the destination area received the parcel; the remark names it.
The destination hub received the parcel; the remark reads "Ready for delivery".
The parcel is handed to a partner for the onward leg; the remark reads "Via land: For transfer to partner".
The parcel is with the delivery rider.
The parcel was delivered; the remark names who took it, which the adapter drops.
The rider could not collect the parcel; the remark gives the reason, such as a merchant cancellation.
The pickup was closed without collecting the parcel.
The booking was cancelled before pickup; the remark says who asked.
A delivery attempt that did not deliver. A delivery partner's remark relays its own status as typed, which can name the person met, so the adapter keeps only the status.
A status filter label in the carrier's web app bundle; tracker events may differ in case.
A status filter label in the carrier's web app bundle; tracker events may differ in case.
